hints.content: Multiples are numbers that result when we multiply one whole number by another whole number.

We want to find multiples of $\greenD{10}$.

$\begin{align}
\greenD{10}\times1=10\\\\
\greenD{10}\times2=20\\\\
\greenD{10}\times3=30\\\\
\greenD{10}\times4=40\\\\
\greenD{10}\times5=50
\end{align}$

question.content:
**Which of the following shows only multiples of $10$?**
